title: Logo / interface and campaign variants
slide_intent: Compare a mark across small interfaces and image-led messages so scale changes remain legible.
strategic_value: Consistent DB contours can connect digital service and advertising encounters.
demonstration: A phone with a centered red mark sits beside a photographed campaign with a white mark; two isolated red variants appear at right.
practical_value: Check whether the selected variant remains clear on a device, photograph and flat field.

content_islands.spec: Show the red mark on a sparse phone screen at left.

content_islands.name: Campaign specimen
content_islands.spec: Place the white mark on the portrait photograph in the middle.

content_islands.name: Variant swatches
content_islands.spec: Stack red-logo specimens on dark and light fields at right.
